title: Existence of the page-two spectral-sequence map
statement: Let C be an abelian category and let X and Y be EInt-indexed abelian spectral objects. Every morphism φ : X ⟶ Y induces a morphism e : X.E₂SpectralSequence ⟶ Y.E₂SpectralSequence such that for every p,q the page-two component of e, followed by the canonical first-page comparison for Y, equals the canonical first-page comparison for X followed by the component of φ on H^(p+q)(q,q+1).

source.place: Tags 012K and 015K; finite kernel/image page maps and compatibility of connecting maps

proof.text: For each page and bidegree, use the morphism of spectral objects to obtain compatible maps between the three-term complexes defining pageX. The induced kernel and image maps define the page component and satisfy the page differential equation.

The same kernel/image universal-property equations identify the induced maps with the successor-page homology maps, so the page components form a morphism of spectral sequences. At page two these equations give the displayed first-page comparison formula.

theorem exists_pageTwoMap_data
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C]
    {X Y : SpectralObject C EInt} (φ : X ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ e : X.E₂SpectralSequence ⟶ Y.E₂SpectralSequence,
      ∀ (p q : ℤ),
        (e.hom 2).f (p, q) ≫
            ((HomologicalComplex.eval C _ (p, q)).mapIso
              ((SpectralSequence.pageFunctor C _ 2 2).mapIso (Iso.refl _)) ≪≫
            Y.spectralSequenceFirstPageXIso coreE₂Cohomological (p, q) _ _ rfl rfl
              (p + q) rfl).hom =
          ((HomologicalComplex.eval C _ (p, q)).mapIso
              ((SpectralSequence.pageFunctor C _ 2 2).mapIso (Iso.refl _)) ≪≫
            X.spectralSequenceFirstPageXIso coreE₂Cohomological (p, q) _ _ rfl rfl
              (p + q) rfl).hom ≫
            (φ.hom (p + q)).app (ComposableArrows.mk₁
              (homOfLE (by simp : (q : EInt) ≤ ((q + 1 : ℤ) : EInt))))
